paused.description: The live Pi host's pause flag, absent when there is no host state.

local.description:
True on the Unix socket or when the daemon's TCP peer is loopback, false otherwise.
Describes the immediate connection, not client location or authority. Absent on older daemons.

ArtifactNarrowing.description: All supplied filters must match. Prefixes are case-insensitive.

content.description:
UTF-8 text or one independently base64-encoded byte chunk.
The complete JSON-RPC reply remains within APP_CONTROL_MAX.

key.description: Catalog key within that owner, not a filesystem path.

task.description: Owner ID: the task for an artifact, or the message for an attachment.

truncated.description: More source content exists; continue with DetailReply.next.

AssistantCancelRequest.description:
Input cancellation names the submitted message; direct cancellation
names the session and optionally the turn.

connection.description: Frozen host billing/auth route, not inferred from mutable profile configuration.

question_id.description: Host question id for the owner prompt shown while Waiting.

oneOf.description:
Fence the session: its host stays up and queued messages wait. An owner message or
`resume` lifts it.
Fenced by the owner: alive, queued messages wait until resumed.

BoardCursor.description:
`after = Some(id)` resumes within `rev`; None has consumed that whole revision.
The empty starting cursor is `{ rev: 0, after: None }`.

events.description: `created` and `landed` events are sufficient to draw the burn-up.

total.description:
Exact owner-relevant totals, independent of page size and history cursor.
Unknown only when talking to an older daemon.

older.description: Opaque exclusive `before` anchor for the next older page, if any.

rows.description:
Most recently updated first, ties by task number descending; at most
CLOSED_PAGE_MAX rows.

total.description:
Exact count of closed tasks, independent of the requested anchor; None when the
daemon cannot count it without reading closed history.

ConfigDocument.description: The `config.get` result and `config.put` parameters. Raw TOML preserves comments and formatting.

revision.description: Content fingerprint of the returned file; not a write precondition.

status.description: Absent when the dependency task is unavailable.

time_zone.description: IANA time zone name for local day boundaries, including clock changes.

to.description: Exclusive local date; a range may span at most 366 days.

utc_offset_minutes.description: Fixed minutes east of UTC (`-1439..=1439`), used when no zone is given.

filter.description: Whitespace-separated words, all of which must match.

oneOf.description: Attachment bytes are returned as `DetailBody::Artifact`, as in the chat wire.
Closed tasks, newest first; `before` is a page's opaque `older` anchor.

body.description: None means not modified, not an empty or unavailable detail.

last_seen.description: Coarse RFC3339 time of authenticated activity, not an online indicator.

DevicePageQuery.description: App-safe device enumeration without changing the Unix device.list contract.

after.description: Resume strictly after this canonical device ID.

limit.description: At most DEVICE_PAGE_LIMIT_MAX; replies also obey APP_CONTROL_MAX.

EffectiveProjectSettings.description: Project settings after applying workspace defaults, before task-specific overrides.

base.description: The configured or discovered base; absent when discovery cannot determine one.

command.description: Historical display data, not a command that can be submitted.

accepts_text.description: Whether the historical question card offered an owner reply.

revision.description: Canonical PM inbox revision used by pm.inbox-withdraw, not ThreadEntry.rev.

bytes.description: Whole canonical content length in UTF-8 bytes at this revision.

complete.description: No more content will be appended. All `total` parts must still be collected.

id.description: Semantic message ID; answers use the live stream's `<message>/answer/0` anchor.

index.description: Zero-based transport part position, independent of page boundaries.

last_sync_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp, absent until the first sync completes.

slots.description: Dispatch occupancy and limits, absent when the engine cannot be observed.

address.description: The address actually bound by the daemon, including its port.

LiveText.description: UTF-8 text offset in bytes; acknowledged pages advance the running turn.

completed.description:
True only after a full pass that started after receipt of this nudge completed
within the requested wait. Finishing an already-running pass does not qualify.

PaneFocus.description: Resolve the pane from the stored run rather than taking a runner ID from the client.

PaneKeys.description: Resolve the pane from the stored run rather than taking a runner ID from the client.

text.description: Literal text, delivered before any keys, without implicitly submitting it.

candidate.description: Immutable identity of the run whose stored diff is being paged.

patch.description: At most 48 KiB; remaining text is fetched with DetailReply.next.

child_rows.description:
Enriched rows for the same children, in the same order on each page, likewise without
their `body`.

children.description:
The children without their `body`, which each child's own task detail serves. Each
child's `depends_on` describes its dependency edges.

parent.description: The parent's `body` is the Markdown document.

ProjectRow.description: A configured project and the count of tasks that are neither Done nor Dropped.

config.description: Parsed `[projects.<id>]` as serialized by the engine.

local_branches.description: Local branch names, most recently committed first; absent if unavailable.

open_by_status.description: Counts exclude Done and Dropped; an empty vector means no open tasks.

endpoint.description: HTTPS push-service URL, never the daemon endpoint.

consequence_derived.description: At least one consequence field was inferred from canonical task dependencies.

consequence_missing.description: No option-specific consequence was recorded or safely derived.

evidence.description: Zero-based index into this detail's evidence blocks.

endpoint.description: WebSocket base URL, without an application path or credentials.

Response.description: A response has exactly one result or error. A successful null result is preserved.

ReviewCandidate.description: Immutable identity of the coding candidate whose patch is being displayed.

checks.description: Recorded gate and review checks in insertion order; may span detail pages.

run.description: The candidate run contains the summary and commit recorded at `done`.

at.description: Epoch milliseconds, as in the host fleet journal.

text.description: At most 2,048 Unicode characters; oldest entries are removed to fit a page.

turn.description: If present, cancel only this turn.

SessionChild.description: Bounded app projection; no child instructions, transcripts, reports or paths.

verdict.description: `approve` or `changes` when a review child records its verdict.

messages.description: Newest at most 100 entries, in journal order.

messages_total.description: Includes messages removed by journal retention and page byte bounds.

arguments.description: Pretty JSON, not a flattened argument description.

call.description: Original call metadata, including argument validation errors and namespaces.

result.description: Complete structured result, including images and presenter-specific details.

oneOf.description: All persisted fields read by an extension presenter, without reducing them to prose.
Immediately follows the preview it replaces. Fetch and concatenate JSON fragments.

json.description: A UTF-8 fragment of the complete serialized SessionItem.

SessionLiveEvent.description:
Text/thinking offsets are UTF-8 bytes, independent per (generation, turn, message,
kind). Applying chunks at their offsets, rather than appending, is idempotent.

oneOf.description: The optional page-level fleet is a current replacement, not a turn delta.

SessionLiveGap.description:
Drop the live overlay and reconcile from `detail.get { session }`. A zero
`missing` still signals discontinuity (generation change or unavailable host).

SessionPromptAnswer.description: `prompt.answer` accepts a Pi question ID and a choice, free text, or both.

built_in_defaults.description: Built-in engine configuration with no workspace overrides.

config.description: Parsed `corral.toml` as serialized by the engine; empty on a parse error.

problem.description: Parse problem in an externally edited file; `config.get` still returns the raw TOML.

project_defaults.description: Unconfigured project resolved against the built-in workspace defaults.

revision.description: Content fingerprint of `corral.toml`, including comments and formatting.

used.description: Running and Blocked tasks currently occupying slots.

projects.description: Only projects with an explicit running limit.

StopAck.description: Acceptance is not proof of abort; only canonical `ThreadEntry.completion` attests settlement.

oneOf.description: The requested turn is no longer running, not necessarily because it was aborted.
One bounded page in flight; `left` contains removed row IDs.

rows.description: A health page contains the single current snapshot.

oneOf.description: One bounded page in flight; `left` contains removed row IDs.
One bounded page in flight; `left` contains removed row IDs.
One bounded page in flight; `left` contains removed row IDs.
One bounded page in flight; `left` contains removed row IDs.
One bounded page in flight; `left` contains removed row IDs.
One bounded page in flight; `left` contains removed row IDs.
One bounded page in flight; `left` contains removed row IDs.

fleet.description: Current fleet replacement for capable clients; omission means no current fleet.

snapshot.description: Complete bounded replacement window; absent on an unavailable pane.

TaskRow.description: One task in the open board or a plan. Checks are for its current HEAD and review round.

dependencies.description: In `task.depends_on` order, including dependencies that are no longer open.

max_rounds.description: Effective limit for this task, including project overrides.

ready.description: Whether the pipeline appended `ready` for the current review.

resolved_profile.description: Worker profile dispatch would select without an explicit override.

reviewer.description: Live reviewer session, even when `run` holds the worker.

TerminalColor.description:
A terminal colour: an index into the 256-colour palette (0-15 are the client's theme
colours), or a 24-bit `[red, green, blue]`.

TerminalRun.description:
Consecutive cells of one terminal row that share a style. An absent colour is the terminal's
default for that ground; the client owns the defaults and the indexed palette.

inverse.description: Foreground and background swapped (SGR 7), resolved by the client against its defaults.

lines.description:
Latest bounded scrollback plus screen, in display order. Stream pages replace this
window, never append repeated screen rows. Recorded gates remain non-live captures.

rows.description:
The same lines as styled runs, one row per line, when the source carries styling (a live
pane's screen); empty otherwise. A row's run texts concatenate to its line.

completion.description: Canonical host settlement, never inferred from a Stop request or a generic done stream.

cost_usd.description: One semantic answer's amount, carried only by part zero. None means unknown, never zero.

part.description: Absent on older servers; continuation IDs remain readable as legacy transport parts.

typed_at.description: Original owner-typed RFC 3339 time; `at` remains the canonical receipt/order time.

days.description: Ascending days, including days without any reports or runs.

schema.description: Content fingerprint of the returned file; not a write precondition.
Literal text, delivered before any keys, without implicitly submitting it.
Current fleet replacement for capable clients; omission means no current fleet.

anyOf.description: A health page contains the single current snapshot.

schema.description: Complete bounded replacement window; absent on an unavailable pane.
Whitespace-separated words, all of which must match.
IANA time zone name for local day boundaries, including clock changes.

anyOf.description: Exclusive local date; a range may span at most 366 days.

schema.description: Fixed minutes east of UTC (`-1439..=1439`), used when no zone is given.
If present, cancel only this turn.
Resume strictly after this canonical device ID.
